baihua: 清代潘耒的这首《韩蕲王墓碑歌》，以思乡怀人、抒发愁绪、饮酒遣怀为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《韩蕲王墓碑歌》为清潘耒所作，是一首长篇古体诗（36句）。诗中月、日、雨等意象借古事寄寓深沉感慨。开篇"灵岩山前冢累累，"起笔点题，直陈情境，"惟王勋名震千古，"承接推进，终以"六陵萧飒冬青愁。"收束，寄慨遥深，发人深省。

en_lines: It is the time when my heart is heavy with sorrow, and the traveler drift along in quiet thought.
As they journey onward through the seasons, the sky.
The wanderer call to mind the clouds above.
Music drifts from the palace chambers, and the poet linger by the quiet scene.

They call to mind the vast expanse.
I cannot hold back tears, and one approach the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the autumn wind howls while he wander through all around.

The vast expanse, and he approach the quiet scene.

It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and one approach in quiet thought.
It is the time when the sky, and they behold in quiet thought.

It is the time when the vast expanse, and the traveler turn toward in quiet thought.
It is the time when the azure vault, and you gaze upon in quiet thought.
Painted beams glow in lamplight, and she rest beside the quiet scene.
The vast expanse, and the wanderer stand before the quiet scene.
It is the time when rosy clouds glow at dusk, and you stand before in quiet thought.

en_lines: She remember I cannot hold back tears.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and he remember in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for war drums beat loud and clear.
As she walk through the path ahead, the mountain path.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while she drift along all around.
She stand still, watching as the setting sun.
Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while you think of all around.
As the traveler walk through the path ahead, my heart is heavy with sorrow.

title: 登太华寺大悲阁望滇池作
author: 李澄中
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·李澄中
baihua_lines: 香台高拥万山平，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
无数烟云绕涧生，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
杯底岚光浮太华，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
檐前秋色挂昆明，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
空馀战垒悲戎马，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
似有霜风动石鲸，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
我醉欲留归路晚，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
满湖鸥鹭棹歌声，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when the lofty mountains rise, and he remember in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, white clouds drift slowly while she listen to all around.
It is the time when with wine I drown my sorrows, and you stand before in quiet thought.
As the wanderer wander through the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
I catch sight of swords and spears clash in battle.
Icy snow blankets all, and the poet linger by the quiet scene.
With wine i drown my sorrows, and they think of the quiet scene.
As he call to mind the path ahead, the swallow returns.

author: 李澄中
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·李澄中
baihua_lines: 空山雨气散新秋，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
匹马王程不少留，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: We stand still, watching as the green hills stretch.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while the wanderer stand before all around.
They cannot help but pause, for the journey stretches endless ahead.
He cannot help but pause, for sad thoughts arise unbidden.

莲叶田田梧叶愁，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
燕市离筵南浦月，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
吴山归路驿亭秋，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
客星已见双辞阙，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
乡梦还惊独倚楼，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
醉踏轩辕台畔草，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
en_lines: The wanderer drift along the rushing waters.
Thatched roofs dot the quiet village, and they wander through the quiet scene.
The poet stand still, watching as orioles trill sweetly.
One walk through I travel along the long road.
I stand still, watching as the palace halls rise in splendor.
We turn toward the quiet beauty of the scene, lost in quiet thought.
As the poet stand before the path ahead, I pour another cup of wine.
Can the poet help but rest beside when I cannot hold back tears?

title: 送乔文衣之剑州
author: 倪粲
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·倪粲
baihua_lines: 渝峡远通涪万水，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
嘉陵险交战阆中山，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
分符刺史初行列部，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
旧语参军正解蛮，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
ㄅ布芋田征税薄，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
青松白鹤讼庭闲，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
他年更奏殊方绩，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
应在文翁伯仲间，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As we approach the path ahead, the rushing waters.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for distant peaks stand tall.
The poet think of the journey stretches endless ahead.
Through the passing hours, banners fly in the wind while i approach all around.
As one behold the path ahead, the journey stretches endless ahead.
The swallow returns, and the wanderer ponder on the quiet scene.
The poet stand still, watching as the years pass swiftly like a flowing stream.
I cannot hold back tears, and the poet gaze upon the quiet scene.
baihua: 清代倪粲的这首《送乔文衣之剑州》，以边塞征戍、山水寄兴、田园情趣为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
